symptoms.title: Early specks and streaks
symptoms.description: Tiny pale-yellow or reddish-brown specks usually begin on the underside of a leaf and lengthen into streaks parallel to the leaf veins.

symptoms.title: Darkening lesions
symptoms.description: The streaks enlarge and darken from brown to nearly black, becoming narrow oval or elongated spots.

symptoms.title: Gray centers and yellow halos
symptoms.description: Older lesions may develop dry light-gray centers, dark borders, and bright yellow halos.

symptoms.title: Coalescing and leaf death
symptoms.description: Numerous lesions can merge into large dead areas, reducing green leaf area and causing premature drying.

treatment.title: Inspect after rainy periods
treatment.description: Warm, humid weather and prolonged leaf wetness favor Black Sigatoka. In Sto. Tomas City, check both sides of younger leaves after repeated rain and mark plants with spreading streaks.

treatment.title: Remove infected tissue carefully
treatment.description: Cut only heavily spotted or dead leaf portions using disinfected tools. Keep enough healthy leaf area for the plant, and do not carry infected leaves into another growing area.

treatment.title: Improve field conditions
treatment.description: Clear weeds, manage excess suckers, improve airflow and drainage, and maintain balanced nutrition to reduce leaf wetness and plant stress.

treatment.title: Ask the Sto. Tomas City Agriculture Office
treatment.description: For severe or spreading cases, contact the City Agriculture Office at (043) 784-8022 local 307 or agri@cityofstotomas.gov.ph. Use only a Philippine FPA-registered product labeled for banana and Black Sigatoka, exactly as directed.

prevention.title: Prepare for wet weather
prevention.description: Keep canals and drainage paths clear before periods of heavy rain, and avoid irrigation that leaves foliage wet for long periods.

prevention.title: Maintain airflow
prevention.description: Use suitable spacing, control excess suckers and weeds, and remove only severely infected tissue so leaves dry faster.

prevention.title: Use clean planting material and tools
prevention.description: Obtain healthy planting material from a reliable source and disinfect cutting tools between plants and growing areas.

prevention.title: Monitor consistently
prevention.description: Inspect younger leaves every week during humid or rainy conditions so new streaks are managed before lesions merge.
